1)  PUBLIC COMMENT

  a) Members of the public were given the opportunity to directly address the
  Committee on any item listed on the agenda.

  Speakers:  None

2) THE CITY OF BEVERLY HILLS AND BHUSD EXPLORATORY COLLABORATION OF AN
  EARLY CHILDHOOD CENTER.
  Patty Acuna, Assistant Director of Community Services, introduced Beverly Hills Unified School
  District (BHUSD) staff to begin the discussion to explore the collaboration of an Early Childhood
  Center.

  Dr. Michael Bregy, BHUSD Superintendent, presented information regarding the collaboration
  of an Early Childhood Center that included:
  - Proposed space for City Preschool at Horace Mann
  - Potential District Office/BHEF/other space
  - Explore Hawthorne spaces that include possible play area

  A discussion ensued to flush out details such as:
 Beverly Hills City Council Liaison/BHUSD Committee
January 26, 2024
Special Meeting Highlights

  -  Two locations of classes which may include more than one classroom depending on
  enrollment.
  -  Daycare should also be considered.
  -  A previous architect assessed and provided possibly space opportunities.
  -  Possible distribution of summer camps, programs including field uses.
  -  There is a robust waiting list for preschool.

Next Steps to create a Unified Preschool Program:
- Conduct a survey for those already enrolled in preschool programs to identify the number of
  classrooms needed and where it makes more sense to configure those classrooms.
- Identify geographically relocating classes.
- To service the Community, it makes sense to make this program as big as can be allowed as a
  business opportunity and benefit to the Community.
- What would the Timeline and breakeven points be?

Prior to Next Liaison Meeting:
- Distribute an on-line survey to the families of the school district to provide size of interest and
  the results to be provided.
- Determine what programs people are looking for more of?
- BHUSD will provide assessment of space.
- Determine the design of the curriculum. District has informed us that preschool is moving to a
  more play based instruction model.
- Staff to walk the sites to see what is possible.

Mayor Gold requested scheduling two meetings so when his term, along with Councilmember
Bosse’s term ends, this item outline can be presented to the next City Council.

3) ADJOURNMENT

  Date / Time:  January 26, 2024 / 11:06 AM
